title: DojoLiq Sour Peach Gummy 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid by Vaporesso
description: Indulge your sweet tooth with Vaporesso DojoLiq Sour Peach Gummy, a fun and vibrant confectionery blend. The profile opens with the sugary, fruit-filled taste of Peach candy, bringing a distinctively chewy and mellow sweetness to the inhale. This is quickly followed by a tangy, sour coating on the exhale, providing a sharp and playful twist that balances the candy notes perfectly. To ensure peak performance, this Nicotine Salt e-liquid features a finely tuned 45% VG / 55% PG ratio specifically optimised for this blend. This bespoke formulation guarantees rapid wicking and maximum flavour transmission when used with Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) pod systems and starter vape kits. The Nicotine Salt blend ensures a gentle throat feel and fast-acting nicotine relief. Created by industry leaders Vaporesso, the DojoLiq range translates the richly formulated, vivid flavours of their famous Dojo devices into a premium bottled e-liquid. Choose from 10mg or 20mg strengths to find the perfect level of satisfaction for your everyday vaping needs.
